title: Past Perfect Vs Past Indefinite

 Past Perfect Past Indefinite

  Past indefinite Action at a definite time in the past.
  Past Perfect Action completed before another action/time in the past.

 1 PAST INDEFINITE

  Past Indefinite: Past Indefinite tense is used to express an action which takes place in the
 past at a definite time.
Past Indefinite tense is used to show actions that were completed at a specific time in the past.
